description: Defines classes and methods for establishing SOCKS proxy connections, including SOCKSConnectJob and SOCKSSocketParams, with support for SOCKS4/SOCKS5 protocols, connection management, and related parameters.

classes.name: SOCKSSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for SOCKS socket connections, including proxy server details, destination, protocol version, and traffic annotation.

classes.name: SOCKSConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of connecting to a SOCKS proxy server, performing the handshake, and establishing a tunnel.

methods.name: destination
methods.description: Returns the destination host and port.

methods.name: is_socks_v5
methods.description: Indicates if SOCKS v5 protocol is used.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the connection job.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Checks if connection has been established.

methods.name: HandshakeTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Returns the handshake timeout duration for testing.
